query: Voici une page que j'ai déjà publiée. Qu'est-ce qui n'est toujours pas clair ?
files: any previously published page of the series
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/audit-page.py on the page rather than counting by eye or writing a new counter
Reports findings and STOPS - makes no edit and republishes nothing before the user chooses
Gives a verdict per diagram against step 6's routing table and the eleven rules in references/components.md
Lists terms used without a gloss, ranked by how much they block comprehension, starting with the subject's own name if it is undefined
Flags any claim it cannot trace to a file it opened in this session, rather than re-asserting it
Flags anything framed as a to-do list, since the reader is still learning
Does not invent new findings to pad the report - an audit that finds little says so
known_failure_modes: Fixing the page immediately instead of reporting first
Writing an ad-hoc counting script that treats .tldr as empty and reports false empty sections
Reviewing only the prose and leaving the diagrams unexamined
